data.name: Sameed
data.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin meaning 'intelligent', 'sage', 'wise'. Derived from the Arabic root 's-m-d' which means 'to send'. The name of Prophet Sama, a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his wisdom and knowledge.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the inner wisdom and intelligence of the individual, often associated with spiritual growth and understanding.

in_arabic.name: صامد
in_arabic.long_meaning: One who is steadfast, patient, and enduring in times of hardship and adversity. Derived from the root 'samad' (س-م-د) meaning 'to remain steadfast, to last, to endure'.

in_pashto.name: سامد
